QUIC connection allocation, initialization, context access, reason names, and validation init.

# Purpose
This file implements connection management for the QUIC stack. It defines the memory layout, alignment, and footprint rules for `fd_quic_conn_t`, including optional allocation of the per-connection stream map with `fd_quic_stream_map`. The [`fd_quic_conn_new`](<#fd_quic_conn_new>) function initializes a connection object in caller-provided memory, sets the initial connection state, links the connection to the parent `fd_quic_t`, initializes stream lists, packet metadata tracking, and service timers, and updates connection state metrics. The file also provides simple accessors for the user context stored in `fd_quic_conn_t`.

The file also contains support functions for connection reason codes and initialization checks. [`fd_quic_conn_reason_name`](<#fd_quic_conn_reason_name>) maps a QUIC connection reason code to a string name using the `FD_QUIC_REASON_CODES` list. [`fd_quic_conn_validate_init`](<#fd_quic_conn_validate_init>) clears the `visited` flag for all connections in the QUIC state during startup or validation. Overall, this is a C source file that implements internal connection setup and helper logic for the QUIC connection layer.
